FloatingBox variants
|-- Floating panes share pixel geometry and presentation state.
|   |-- Positions use canvas or viewport coordinates.
|   |-- Child IDs, expansion and placement or sizing policies guide presentation.
|   `-- Collapse saves expanded geometry for later restoration.
|-- SelectionRegion retains captured panel context.
|   |-- It records source box, content, ASCII, region and selected IDs.
|   `-- SelectionState separately manages membership and insertion order.
|-- ProjectedPane holds one supported form of projected content.
|   |-- Call-tree content includes a result and coverage.
|   |-- Compaction content carries projected files and source ranges.
|   |-- Source-code content identifies a project and currently viewed file.
|   `-- Code-panel content carries panel data and a selection reference.
|       `-- Saved scroll is a checkpoint; SourcePaneViewState manages live scroll.
|-- ConversationPane and DetailPane carry other presentation data.
|   |-- A conversation retains a thread, draft, presentation and canvas anchor.
|   `-- A detail pane retains a title, ASCII and optional section ID.
|-- DisplayState records roots and floating panes.
|   |-- addDisplayNode links a new pane to a parent or to the roots.
|   |-- removeDisplayNode removes descendants and repairs active-child references.
|   |-- Geometry updates and measurement share one immutable update path.
|   `-- visibleProjectionIds uses expansion and stacked or chained child display.
`-- canvasDisplayNodes combines floating presentation with grid information.
    |-- Automatic selections use captured grid regions for placement.
    |-- Automatic projections can use a parent; conversations use their anchors.
    `-- Arrow values are drawn from document edges, not stored in DisplayState.
        `-- Drawing requires the scene, diagram views, cell size and endpoint bounds.
